vessels.name: Malouka
vessels.summary: A classic Nour El Nil dahabiya with compact cabins and a personal atmosphere, sailing five nights from Esna to Aswan. It stops at El Kab, Edfu, Gebel Silsileh and Kom Ombo, with a full day given to the river. No sailings from June to August.
vessels.description: A classic Nour El Nil dahabiya with 10 cabins and suites for up to 20 guests, compact cabins and a personal atmosphere. It sails five nights from Esna to Aswan, stopping at El Kab, Edfu, Gebel Silsileh and Kom Ombo, with a full day given to the river. There are no sailings from June to August.
vessels.verification_note: Not bookable: shown on /vessels/ as an example only (showcase). Nour El Nil has not yet confirmed that Nilecruz may feature Malouka or use its photos: add no operator photos and imply no partnership until they do. The operator gives two sizes (50 m × 7.7 m and 52 m × 7.5 m), so no length is recorded. Day-by-day itinerary not imported (none supplied).
